d:
Aanand mohan ek bar phir se charcha men hain. jab vo jel se bahar aae to jel mainyual men sanshodhan ke prastav ko lekar bihar men us samay kaee aaeeees adhikariyon ne virodh jataya tha. bataya ja raha hai ki lagbhag sabhi aaeeees adhikari is prastav ke khilaph the, lekin tatkalin mukhyamantri nitish kumar apne phaisle par are rahe aur adhikariyon ke virodh ke bavjud prastav ko manjuri di gaee. aakhir us samay kya huaa tha aur adhikariyon ne kyon jataya tha virodh?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
